Launch of tokenized stocks on Solana with real‑share backing could reshape equity tokenization infrastructure.
Quantified capital‑efficiency gains from tokenized stocks may drive institutional adoption.
Gnosis bridge speed improvement reduces friction for Ethereum deposits, a notable protocol upgrade.

rows.observation: Standard Chartered announced plans to offer crypto custody services in Singapore.
Bitget and Block Scholes reported that tokenized stocks can reduce capital requirements by $165,000 in a $1 million multi-asset portfolio, highlighting capital efficiency benefits.
Bitwise launched a spot NEAR ETF and prioritized AI, with its CEO calling the Dogecoin ETF failure 'tragic' due to the gap between ETF buyers and crypto-app users.
Sam Altman-backed Meanwhile raised $37.5 million to launch the first licensed Bitcoin life insurance product for international clients.
Grayscale's Zcash ETF crossed $1 billion in assets in its first month, drawing attention away from XRP ETFs which hold $1.6 billion.
US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs experienced heavy outflows, with Bitcoin ETFs posting their largest daily outflow since June ($487 million) and Ethereum withdrawals hitting a nine-month high.
ESMA gave EU crypto platforms a three-month deadline to drop non-MiCA stablecoins such as USDT by early January 2027.
The US government moved $1 billion in Bitcoin seized from the Bitfinex hacker to a new unlabeled wallet as BTC prices slid below $81,000.
The IMF warned that tokenized markets could amplify financial risks, finding tokenized equity markets less liquid and more volatile than traditional markets despite growing demand for 24/7 trading.
Securitize launched tokenized stocks of Nvidia, Apple, and Amazon on Solana, backed 1-to-1 by real shares and preserving dividends and voting rights, with NYSE and OKX-ICE venues planned.
Tom Lee predicted a historic, institution-driven crypto bull market with ETH potentially reaching $22K–$62K, despite ETH cratering 5% in the short term.
A new report from zerohash and Ava Labs identified regulatory clarity as the biggest barrier and unlock for institutional crypto adoption.
Rep. French Hill called for permanent crypto legislation, hoping the Clarity Act returns and passes this year alongside SEC/CFTC progress.
Neocloud stocks like IREN and Nebius faced sharp declines due to falling crypto prices and rising borrowing costs as bond yields hit 5.7%.
Custodians entered 'bunker mode' to rethink multi-chain key management due to accelerating AI and quantum decryption risks.
Gnosis bridges reduced Ethereum deposit waits to seconds with fast confirmation.
BaFin rejected futurum bank AG's MiCA application, forcing the German crypto platform into an operational overhaul pending partnerships with regulated entities.
Bitcoin dipped near three-week lows below $81,000 as oil prices surged on Iran tanker attacks, hurricane threats to US Gulf production, and potential US military escalation.
Coinbase partnered with Samsung to integrate USDC directly into Samsung Wallet, reaching 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US starting late October.
A $1,000 MetaMask staking incident risked turning Ethereum's staking queue into a $5 billion traffic jam, though Lido expected a gradual re-entry of the identified exit cohort.
